facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 December 2008 a near hit was recorded on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
